```{r include = F}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, 
                      fig.align='center', fig.dim=c(10, 8))
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(broom)
library(knitr)
library(visdat)
library(DT)
library(patchwork)
library(readr)
library(naniar)
library(GGally)
```

This document will aim to analyse the NHS data sets. We will try to do it for one data set and see if we can generalise/automate the process. We start with `AHSnhs11b14.csv`.

# `AHSnhs11b14.csv` Data Set

We take the non-ID related columns, which are `TOTPALCR`, `TOTALCC`, `ALCSDCDT`, `ALCORD` and `ALCTYPT`, and turn the placeholder missing values into `NA` based on the metadata descriptions. Note that some patients have more than one entry here, as we will also count the total number of unique IDs.

```{r}
# Data Cleaning
nhs1 = read_csv(here("NHS", "AHSnhs11b14.csv"))
counts = c(dim(nhs1)[1], n_distinct(nhs1$ABSLID))
cat("Total =", counts[1], "\nUnique =", counts[2])

nhs1.data = nhs1 %>% select(ABSLID:ALCTYPT) %>% 
  mutate(TOTPALCR = case_when(TOTPALCR %in% c(0, 999998) ~ NA,
                              TRUE ~ TOTPALCR),
         TOTALCC = case_when(TOTALCC %in% c(0, 999998) ~ NA,
                             TRUE ~ TOTALCC),
         ALCSDCDT = case_when(ALCSDCDT == 99 ~ NA, 
                              ALCSDCDT == 98 ~ NA, 
                              TRUE ~ ALCSDCDT),
         ALCORD = case_when(ALCORD == 0 ~ NA,
                            ALCORD == 1 ~ "Most recent",
                            ALCORD == 2 ~ "Second most recent",
                            ALCORD == 3 ~ "Third most recent") %>% as.factor(),
         ALCTYPT = case_when(ALCTYPT == 0 ~ NA,
                             ALCTYPT == 1 ~ "Low alcohol beer",
                             ALCTYPT == 2 ~ "Mid strength beer",
                             ALCTYPT == 3 ~ "Full strength beer",
                             ALCTYPT == 4 ~ "White wine",
                             ALCTYPT == 5 ~ "Red wine",
                             ALCTYPT == 6 ~ "Low alcohol wine",
                             ALCTYPT == 7 ~ "Champagne/sparkling wine",
                             ALCTYPT == 8 ~ "Ready to drink spirits/liqueurs",
                             ALCTYPT == 9 ~ "Liqueurs",
                             ALCTYPT == 10 ~ "Spirits",
                             ALCTYPT == 11 ~ "Fortified wine",
                             ALCTYPT == 12 ~ "Cider",
                             ALCTYPT == 13 ~ "Cocktail",
                             ALCTYPT == 14 ~ "Other") %>% as.factor())

# Visualise Missing Data
gg_miss_var(nhs1.data)

# Summary Statistics
summary(nhs1.data)

# Visual Summaries
nhs1_long = nhs1.data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(TOTPALCR, ALCSDCDT, TOTALCC), 
               names_to = "Variable",
               values_to = "Value")
ggplot(nhs1_long, aes(x = Value)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "#69b3a2", color = "#e9ecef", alpha = 0.9) +
  labs(y = "Frequency", title = "Distribution of Alcohol Metrics", x = "Value") +
  theme_linedraw() +
  facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free")

# Tabular Summaries
table(nhs1.data$ALCORD)
table(nhs1.data$ALCTYPT)

# Bivariate Analysis
nhs1.data.numeric = nhs1.data %>% select(TOTPALCR:ALCSDCDT)
ggpairs(nhs1.data.numeric, title = "Pairs Plot of AHSbhs11b14 Data Set")
```

It seems that they are quite highly correlated, as also seen in the histogram having similar distributions.

# `AHSnhs11ba3.csv` Data Set

We will do the same analysis as above, and potentially here we can check relationships between the numeric and categorical variables as well.

```{r}
# Data Cleaning
nhs2 = read_csv(here("NHS", "AHSnhs11ba3.csv"))
counts = c(dim(nhs2)[1], n_distinct(nhs2$ABSLID))
cat("Total =", counts[1], "\nUnique =", counts[2])
nhs2.data = nhs2 %>% select(ABSLID:DAY3ALC) %>% 
  mutate(TOTPA3CR = case_when(TOTPA3CR %in% c(0, 999998) ~ NA,
                              TRUE ~ TOTPA3CR),
         ALCORD = case_when(ALCORD == 0 ~ NA,
                            ALCORD == 1 ~ "Most recent",
                            ALCORD == 2 ~ "Second most recent",
                            ALCORD == 3 ~ "Third most recent") %>% as.factor(),
         DAY3ALC = case_when(DAY3ALC == 0 ~ NA,
                             DAY3ALC == 1 ~ "Monday",
                             DAY3ALC == 2 ~ "Tuesday",
                             DAY3ALC == 3 ~ "Wednesday",
                             DAY3ALC == 4 ~ "Thursday",
                             DAY3ALC == 5 ~ "Friday",
                             DAY3ALC == 6 ~ "Saturday",
                             DAY3ALC == 7 ~ "Sunday") %>% as.factor())

# Visualise Missing Data
gg_miss_var(nhs2.data)

# Summary Statistics
summary(nhs2.data)

# Visual Summary
ggplot(nhs2.data, aes(x = TOTPA3CR)) + 
  geom_histogram(fill = "#69b3a2", color = "#e9ecef", alpha = 0.9) +
  labs(y = "Frequency", title = "Distribution of TOTPA3CR", 
       x = "Pure Alcohol Consumption (ml)") +
  theme_linedraw()

data_b1 = nhs2.data %>% filter(!is.na(ALCORD))
data_b2 = nhs2.data %>% filter(!is.na(DAY3ALC))

b1 = ggplot(data_b1, aes(x = ALCORD, y = TOTPA3CR, fill = ALCORD)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Pure Alcohol Consumption by Order", 
       x = "Alcohol Order", y = "TOTPA3CR") +
  theme_linedraw() + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")
b2 = ggplot(data_b2, aes(x = DAY3ALC, y = TOTPA3CR, fill = DAY3ALC)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Pure Alcohol Consumption by Day", x = "Day", y = "TOTPA3CR") +
  theme_linedraw() + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")
b1 + b2

# Tabular Summaries
table(nhs2.data$ALCORD)
table(nhs2.data$DAY3ALC)
table(nhs2.data$ALCORD, nhs2.data$DAY3ALC)
```

# `AHSnhs11bac.csv` Data Set

For this data set, we have multiple responses for some variables, so we will try to combine those variables into one that contains a list of them instead. In this case, we also turn the "Not Applicable" values to `NA` as well, but this can be changed if needed.

```{r}
# Data Cleaning
nhs3 = read_csv(here("NHS", "AHSnhs11bac.csv"))
counts = c(dim(nhs3)[1], n_distinct(nhs3$ABSLID))
cat("Total =", counts[1], "\nUnique =", counts[2])
nhs3.data = nhs3 %>% select(ABSLID:ACTFLG) %>% 
  mutate(DAYOFFSC = case_when(DAYOFFSC %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA,
                              TRUE ~ DAYOFFSC),
         DAYOFFWC = case_when(DAYOFFWC %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA,
                              TRUE ~ DAYOFFWC),
         TIMEGPC = case_when(TIMEGPC %in% c(96, 97, 98, 99) ~ NA,
                             TRUE ~ TIMEGPC),
         TIMESPC = case_when(TIMESPC %in% c(96, 97, 98, 99) ~ NA,
                             TRUE ~ TIMESPC),
         ACT2WKSA = case_when(ACT2WKSA %in% c(96, 97, 98, 99) ~ NA,
                              TRUE ~ ACT2WKSA),
         ACT2WKS = pmap(list(ACT2WKSA, ACT2WKSB, ACT2WKSC, ACT2WKSD, 
                             ACT2WKSE, ACT2WKSF, ACT2WKSG), function(...) {
                               vals = c(...)
                               if (anyNA(vals)) NA else vals
                              }),
         ACTGP12M = case_when(ACTGP12M %in% c(0, 6, 8) ~ NA,
                              ACTGP12M == 1 ~ "Consulted",
                              ACTGP12M == 5 ~ "Did Not Consult"),
         ACTSP12M = case_when(ACTSP12M %in% c(0, 6, 8) ~ NA,
                              ACTSP12M == 1 ~ "Consulted",
                              ACTSP12M == 5 ~ "Did Not Consult"),
         ACTWOHPA = case_when(ACTWOHPA %in% c(96, 97, 98, 99) ~ NA,
                              TRUE ~ ACTWOHPA),
         ACTWOHP = pmap(list(ACTWOHPA, ACTWOHPB, ACTWOHPC, ACTWOHPD, ACTWOHPE,
                             ACTWOHPF, ACTWOHPG, ACTWOHPH, ACTWOHPI, ACTWOHPJ,
                             ACTWOHPK, ACTWOHPL, ACTWOHPM, ACTWOHPN, ACTWOHPO,
                             ACTWOHPP), function(...) {
                               vals = c(...)
                               if (anyNA(vals)) NA else vals
                             }),
         DAYSOFF = case_when(DAYSOFF %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                             DAYSOFF == 1 ~ "Yes",
                             DAYSOFF == 5 ~ "No"),
         VISITOHP = case_when(VISITOHP %in% c(0, 6, 8) ~ NA,
                              VISITOHP == 1 ~ "Consulted",
                              VISITOHP == 5 ~ "Did Not Consult"),
         NHPACONS = case_when(NHPACONS %in% c(0, 6, 8) ~ NA,
                              NHPACONS == 1 ~ "Consulted",
                              NHPACONS == 5 ~ "Did Not Consult"),
         ACTQ12 = case_when(ACTQ12 %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                             ACTQ12 == 1 ~ "Yes",
                             ACTQ12 == 5 ~ "No"),
         ACTQ15 = case_when(ACTQ15 %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                             ACTQ15 == 1 ~ "Yes",
                             ACTQ15 == 5 ~ "No"),
         CONNUMC = as.factor(CONNUMC),
         ACTFLG = as.factor(ACTFLG)) %>% 
  select(-c(LEVEL6, ACTWOHPA, ACTWOHPB, ACTWOHPC, ACTWOHPD, ACTWOHPE,
            ACTWOHPF, ACTWOHPG, ACTWOHPH, ACTWOHPI, ACTWOHPJ,
            ACTWOHPK, ACTWOHPL, ACTWOHPM, ACTWOHPN, ACTWOHPO, 
            ACTWOHPP, ACT2WKSA, ACT2WKSB, ACT2WKSC, ACT2WKSD, 
            ACT2WKSE, ACT2WKSF, ACT2WKSG))

# Visualise Missing Data
gg_miss_var(nhs3.data)

# Summary Statistics
table(nhs3.data$ACTGP12M)
table(nhs3.data$ACTSP12M)
table(nhs3.data$DAYSOFF)
table(nhs3.data$VISITOHP)
table(nhs3.data$NHPACONS)
table(nhs3.data$ACTQ12)
table(nhs3.data$ACTQ15)
table(nhs3.data$CONNUMC)
table(nhs3.data$ACTFLG)

# Visual Summaries
nhs3.data.numeric = nhs3.data %>% select(c(DAYOFFSC, DAYOFFWC, TIMEGPC, TIMESPC))
ggpairs(nhs3.data.numeric, title = "Pairs Plot of AHSbhs11bac Data Set")

# Boxplot against CONNUMC (condition type)
b1 = ggplot(nhs3.data, aes(x = CONNUMC, y = DAYOFFSC, fill = CONNUMC)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Days off School per Condition", 
       x = "Condition Number", y = "DAYOFFSC") +
  theme_linedraw() + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")
b2 = ggplot(nhs3.data, aes(x = CONNUMC, y = DAYOFFWC, fill = CONNUMC)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Days off Work per Condition", 
       x = "Condition Number", y = "DAYOFFWC") +
  theme_linedraw() + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")
b3 = ggplot(nhs3.data, aes(x = CONNUMC, y = TIMEGPC, fill = CONNUMC)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "GP Consultations per Condition", 
       x = "Condition Number", y = "TIMEGPC") +
  theme_linedraw() + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")
b4 = ggplot(nhs3.data, aes(x = CONNUMC, y = TIMESPC, fill = CONNUMC)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Specialist Consultations per Condition", 
       x = "Condition Number", y = "TIMESPC") +
  theme_linedraw() + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")
b1 + b2
b3 + b4
```

# `AHSnhs11bbi.csv` Data Set

We ignore the usual identifier variables, and also the replicate weights. Most of these variables seem to be categorical.

```{r}
# Data Cleaning
nhs4 = read_csv(here("NHS", "AHSnhs11bbi.csv"))
counts = c(dim(nhs4)[1], n_distinct(nhs4$ABSLID))
cat("Total =", counts[1], "\nUnique =", counts[2])
nhs4.data = nhs4 %>% select(c(ABSLID:BIORESPC, NHMSPERW:ABSPID)) %>% 
  mutate(TRIGRESB = case_when(TRIGRESB %in% c(97, 98) ~ NA,
                              TRIGRESB == 1 ~ "Less than 0.5",
                              TRIGRESB == 2 ~ "0.5 to less than 1.0",
                              TRIGRESB == 3 ~ "1.0 to less than 1.5",
                              TRIGRESB == 4 ~ "1.5 to less than 2.0",
                              TRIGRESB == 5 ~ "2.0 to less than 2.5",
                              TRIGRESB == 6 ~ "2.5 to less than 3.0",
                              TRIGRESB == 7 ~ "3.0 or more") %>% as.factor(),
         CHOLRESB = case_when(CHOLRESB %in% c(97, 98) ~ NA,
                              CHOLRESB == 1 ~ "Less than 4.0",
                              CHOLRESB == 2 ~ "4.0 to less than 4.5",
                              CHOLRESB == 3 ~ "4.5 to less than 5.0",
                              CHOLRESB == 4 ~ "5.0 to less than 5.5",
                              CHOLRESB == 5 ~ "5.5 to less than 6.0",
                              CHOLRESB == 6 ~ "6.0 to less than 6.5",
                              CHOLRESB == 7 ~ "6.5 to less than 7.0",
                              CHOLRESB == 8 ~ "7.0 or more") %>% as.factor(),
         HDLCHREB = case_when(HDLCHREB %in% c(7, 8) ~ NA,
                              HDLCHREB == 1 ~ "Less than 1.0",
                              HDLCHREB == 2 ~ "1.0 to less than 1.3",
                              HDLCHREB == 3 ~ "1.3 to less than 1.5",
                              HDLCHREB == 4 ~ "1.5 to less than 2.0",
                              HDLCHREB == 5 ~ "2.0 to less than 2.5",
                              HDLCHREB == 6 ~ "2.5 or more") %>% as.factor(),
         LDLRESB = case_when(LDLRESB %in% c(97, 98) ~ NA,
                             LDLRESB == 1 ~ "Less than 1.5",
                             LDLRESB == 2 ~ "1.5 to less than 2.0",
                             LDLRESB == 3 ~ "2.0 to less than 2.5",
                             LDLRESB == 4 ~ "2.5 to less than 3.0",
                             LDLRESB == 5 ~ "3.0 to less than 3.5",
                             LDLRESB == 6 ~ "3.5 to less than 4.0",
                             LDLRESB == 7 ~ "4.0 or less than 4.5",
                             LDLRESB == 8 ~ "4.5 or more") %>% as.factor(),
         APOBRESB = case_when(APOBRESB %in% c(97, 98) ~ NA,
                              APOBRESB == 1 ~ "0.7 or less",
                              APOBRESB == 2 ~ "More than 0.7 to 0.8",
                              APOBRESB == 3 ~ "More than 0.8 to 0.9",
                              APOBRESB == 4 ~ "More than 0.9 to 1.0",
                              APOBRESB == 5 ~ "More than 1.0 to 1.1",
                              APOBRESB == 6 ~ "More than 1.1 to 1.2",
                              APOBRESB == 7 ~ "More than 1.2 to 1.3",
                              APOBRESB == 8 ~ "More than 1.3 to 1.4",
                              APOBRESB == 9 ~ "More than 1.4") %>% as.factor(),
         EGFRRESB = case_when(EGFRRESB %in% c(7, 8) ~ NA,
                              EGFRRESB == 1 ~ "90 or more",
                              EGFRRESB == 2 ~ "75 to 89",
                              EGFRRESB == 3 ~ "60 to 74",
                              EGFRRESB == 4 ~ "45 to 59",
                              EGFRRESB == 5 ~ "30 to 44",
                              EGFRRESB == 6 ~ "Less than 30") %>% as.factor(),
         ALTRESB = case_when(ALTRESB %in% c(97, 98) ~ NA,
                             ALTRESB == 1 ~ "Less than 10",
                             ALTRESB == 2 ~ "10 to less than 15",
                             ALTRESB == 3 ~ "15 to less than 20",
                             ALTRESB == 4 ~ "20 to less than 25",
                             ALTRESB == 5 ~ "25 to less than 30",
                             ALTRESB == 6 ~ "30 to less than 35",
                             ALTRESB == 7 ~ "35 to less than 40",
                             ALTRESB == 8 ~ "40 to less than 45",
                             ALTRESB == 9 ~ "45 to less than 50",
                             ALTRESB == 10 ~ "More than 50") %>% as.factor(),
         GGTRESB = case_when(GGTRESB %in% c(97, 98) ~ NA,
                             GGTRESB == 1 ~ "10 or less",
                             GGTRESB == 2 ~ "More than 10 to 15",
                             GGTRESB == 3 ~ "More than 15 to 20",
                             GGTRESB == 4 ~ "More than 20 to 25",
                             GGTRESB == 5 ~ "More than 25 to 30",
                             GGTRESB == 6 ~ "More than 30 to 35",
                             GGTRESB == 7 ~ "More than 35 to 40",
                             GGTRESB == 8 ~ "More than 40 to 45",
                             GGTRESB == 9 ~ "More than 45 to 50",
                             GGTRESB == 10 ~ "More than 50 to 55",
                             GGTRESB == 11 ~ "More than 55 to 60",
                             GGTRESB == 12 ~ "More than 60") %>% as.factor(),
         FOLATREB = case_when(FOLATREB %in% c(97, 98) ~ NA,

         B12RESB = case_when(B12RESB %in% c(97, 98) ~ NA,
                             B12RESB == 1 ~ "Less than 145",
                             B12RESB == 2 ~ "145 to less than 180",
                             B12RESB == 3 ~ "180 to less than 220",
                             B12RESB == 4 ~ "220 to less than 300",
                             B12RESB == 5 ~ "300 to less than 400",
                             B12RESB == 6 ~ "400 to less than 500",
                             B12RESB == 7 ~ "500 to less than 600",
                             B12RESB == 8 ~ "600 to less than 800",
                             B12RESB == 9 ~ "800 or more") %>% as.factor(),
         FERRCRPB = case_when(FERRCRPB %in% c(97, 98) ~ NA,
                              FERRCRPB == 1 ~ "Less than 12",
                              FERRCRPB == 2 ~ "12 to less than 15",
                              FERRCRPB == 3 ~ "15 to less than 20",
                              FERRCRPB == 4 ~ "20 to less than 30",
                              FERRCRPB == 5 ~ "30 to less than 50",
                              FERRCRPB == 6 ~ "50 to less than 150",
                              FERRCRPB == 7 ~ "150 to less than 200",
                              FERRCRPB == 8 ~ "200 to less than 300",
                              FERRCRPB == 9 ~ "300 to less than 500",
                              FERRCRPB == 10 ~ "500 to less than 750",
                              FERRCRPB == 11 ~ "750 or more") %>% as.factor,
         SOLTRREB = case_when(SOLTRREB %in% c(7, 8) ~ NA,
                              SOLTRREB == 1 ~ "1.5 or less",
                              SOLTRREB == 2 ~ "More than 1.5 to 2.0",
                              SOLTRREB == 3 ~ "More than 2.0 to 2.5",

                              HBA1PREB == 5 ~ "6.5 to less than 7.0",
                              HBA1PREB == 6 ~ "7.0 or more") %>% as.factor(),
         HBA1MREB = case_when(HBA1MREB %in% c(7, 8) ~ NA,
                              HBA1MREB == 1 ~ "Less than 36",
                              HBA1MREB == 2 ~ "36 to less than 39",
                              HBA1MREB == 3 ~ "39 to less than 42",
                              HBA1MREB == 4 ~ "42 to less than 45",
                              HBA1MREB == 5 ~ "45 to less than 48",

         GLUCFREB = case_when(GLUCFREB %in% c(97, 98) ~ NA,

         VDLCMREB = case_when(VDLCMREB %in% c(97, 98) ~ NA,

                              VDLCMREB == 2 ~ "20 to less than 30",
                              VDLCMREB == 3 ~ "30 to less than 40",

                              VDLCMREB == 12 ~ "120 to less than 130",
                              VDLCMREB == 13 ~ "130 or more") %>% as.factor(),
         DIAHBRSK = case_when(DIAHBRSK %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                              DIAHBRSK == 1 ~ "Normal",
                              DIAHBRSK == 2 ~ "At risk of diabetes",

         DIABFPGE = case_when(DIABFPGE %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,

                              DIABFPGE == 2 ~ "Has diabetes - newly diagnosed",
                              DIABFPGE == 3 ~ "Nodiabetes - normal plasma glucose",

         %>% as.factor(),
         DIABPRVE = case_when(DIABPRVE %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                              DIABPRVE == 1 ~ "Has diabetes - known",
                              DIABPRVE == 2 ~ "Has diabetes - newly diagnosed",
                              DIABPRVE == 3 ~ "No diabetes - normal",
                              DIABPRVE == 4 ~ "No diabetes - at risk") %>% as.factor(),
         FASTSTAD = case_when(FASTSTAD == 0 ~ NA,

         BIORESPC = case_when(BIORESPC == 0 ~ NA,
                              BIORESPC == 1 ~ "Not biomedical participant",
                              BIORESPC == 2 ~ "Biomedical participant") 
         %>% as.factor(),
         CHOLNTR = case_when(CHOLNTR %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                             CHOLNTR == 1 ~ "Normal",
                             CHOLNTR == 2 ~ "Abnormal") %>% as.factor(),
         HDLCHNTR = case_when(HDLCHNTR %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                              HDLCHNTR == 1 ~ "Normal",
                              HDLCHNTR == 2 ~ "Abnormal") %>% as.factor(),
         HDLCHSEX = case_when(HDLCHSEX %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                              HDLCHSEX == 1 ~ "Normal",
                              HDLCHSEX == 2 ~ "Abnormal") %>% as.factor(),
         LDLNTR = case_when(LDLNTR %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                            LDLNTR == 1 ~ "Normal",
                            LDLNTR == 2 ~ "Abnormal") %>% as.factor(),
         APOBNTR = case_when(APOBNTR %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                             APOBNTR == 1 ~ "Normal",
                             APOBNTR == 2 ~ "Abnormal") %>% as.factor(),
         TRIGNTR = case_when(TRIGNTR %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                             TRIGNTR == 1 ~ "Normal",
                             TRIGNTR == 2 ~ "Abnormal") %>% as.factor(),
         CVDMEDST = case_when(CVDMEDST %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                              CVDMEDST == 1 ~ "Dyslipidaemia, using medication, abnormal",
                              CVDMEDST == 2 ~ "Dyslipidaemia, using medication, normal",
                              CVDMEDST == 3 ~ "Dyslipidaemia, not using medication, abnormal",
                              CVDMEDST == 4 ~ "No dyslipidaemia") %>% as.factor(),
         EGFRKDSA = case_when(EGFRKDSA %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                              EGFRKDSA == 1 ~ "No indicators of CKD",
                              EGFRKDSA == 2 ~ "Stage 1",
                              EGFRKDSA == 3 ~ "Stage 2",
                              EGFRKDSA == 4 ~ "Stage 3a",
                              EGFRKDSA == 5 ~ "Stage 3b",
                              EGFRKDSA == 6 ~ "Stage 4-5") %>% as.factor(),
         EGFRIMP = case_when(EGFRIMP %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                             EGFRIMP == 1 ~ "Normal",
                             EGFRIMP == 2 ~ "Abnormal") %>% as.factor(),
         ALTNTR = case_when(ALTNTR %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                            ALTNTR == 1 ~ "Normal",
                            ALTNTR == 2 ~ "Abnormal") %>% as.factor(),
         GGTNTR = case_when(GGTNTR == 8 ~ NA,
                            GGTNTR == 1 ~ "Normal",
                            GGTNTR == 2 ~ "Abnormal") %>% as.factor(),
         COTINIES = case_when(COTINIES %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                              COTINIES == 1 ~ "Greater than or equal to 140",
                              COTINIES == 2 ~ "Less than 140") %>% as.factor(),
         DIAHMRSK = case_when(DIAHMRSK %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                              DIAHMRSK == 1 ~ "Normal",
                              DIAHMRSK == 2 ~ "At risk of diabetes",
                              DIAHMRSK == 3 ~ "Indicates diabetes") %>% as.factor(),
         HBDAP = case_when(HBDAP %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                           HBDAP == 1 ~ "Normal haemoglobin",
                           HBDAP == 2 ~ "At risk of anaemia") %>% as.factor(),
         GLUCFPD = case_when(GLUCFPD %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                             GLUCFPD == 1 ~ "No diabetes",
                             GLUCFPD == 2 ~ "Impaired fasting plasma glucose",
                             GLUCFPD == 3 ~ "Indicates diabetes") %>% as.factor(),
         ACRNTR = case_when(ACRNTR %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                            ACRNTR == 1 ~ "No presence of albuminuria",
                            ACRNTR == 2 ~ "Presence of albuminuria") %>% as.factor(),
         ACRIPA = case_when(ACRIPA %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                            ACRIPA == 1 ~ "Normoalbuminuria",
                            ACRIPA == 2 ~ "Microalbuminuria",
                            ACRIPA == 3 ~ "Macroalbuminuria") %>% as.factor(),
         MONTHCOL = case_when(MONTHCOL %in% c(97, 98) ~ NA,
                              MONTHCOL == 1 ~ "January",
                              MONTHCOL == 2 ~ "February",
                              MONTHCOL == 3 ~ "March",
                              MONTHCOL == 4 ~ "April",
                              MONTHCOL == 5 ~ "May",
                              MONTHCOL == 6 ~ "June",
                              MONTHCOL == 7 ~ "July",
                              MONTHCOL == 8 ~ "August",
                              MONTHCOL == 9 ~ "September",
                              MONTHCOL == 10 ~ "October",
                              MONTHCOL == 11 ~ "November",
                              MONTHCOL == 12 ~ "December") %>% as.factor(),
         VDLCMRGT = case_when(VDLCMRGT %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                              VDLCMRGT == 1 ~ "Adequate vitamin D levels",
                              VDLCMRGT == 2 ~ "Mild vitamin D deficiency",
                              VDLCMRGT == 3 ~ "Moderate/severe vitamin D deficiency")
         %>% as.factor())
```

# `AHSnhs11bcn-1.csv` Data Set

For the sake of time, variables like `EVERCURF` will not be transformed in detail.

```{r}
# Data Cleaning
nhs5 = read_csv(here("NHS", "AHSnhs11bcn-1.csv"))
counts = c(dim(nhs5)[1], n_distinct(nhs5$ABSLID))
cat("Total =", counts[1], "\nUnique =", counts[2])
nhs5.data = nhs5 %>% select(ABSLID:INJFLGX) %>% 
  mutate(ALLCON8C = case_when(ALLCON8C %in% c(7, 9) ~ NA,
                              ALLCON8C == 1 ~ "0 to 24 years",
                              ALLCON8C == 2 ~ "25 to 44 years",
                              ALLCON8C == 3 ~ "45 to 64 years",
                              ALLCON8C == 4 ~ "65 years and over") %>% as.factor(),
         MHCAGEC = case_when(MHCAGEC %in% c(7, 8, 9) ~ NA,
                             MHCAGEC == 1 ~ "Less than 25 years",
                             MHCAGEC == 2 ~ "25 to 44 years",
                             MHCAGEC == 3 ~ "45 to 64 years",
                             MHCAGEC == 4 ~ "65 years or over") %>% as.factor(),
         EVERCURF = na_if(EVERCURF, 0) %>% as.factor(),
         ALLERGY = case_when(ALLERGY %in% c(0, 4) ~ NA,
                             ALLERGY == 1 ~ "Anaphylactic",
                             ALLERGY == 2 ~ "Non-anaphylactic",
                             ALLERGY == 3 ~ "Both") %>% as.factor(),
         CONDSTAT = case_when(CONDSTAT == 0 ~ NA,
                              CONDSTAT == 1 ~ "Told, current, long-term",
                              CONDSTAT == 2 ~ "Told, current, not long-term",
                              CONDSTAT == 3 ~ "Told, not current",
                              CONDSTAT == 4 ~ "Not told, current, long term",
                              CONDSTAT == 5 ~ "Not told, not current or long term") 
         %>% as.factor(),
         CONNUMC = as.factor(CONNUMC),
         GLASFLG = case_when(GLASFLG %in% c(0, 6) ~ NA,
                             GLASFLG == 1 ~ "Corrected",
                             GLASFLG == 2 ~ "Not corrected") %>% as.factor(),
         DIABFLG = case_when(DIABFLG %in% c(0, 6) ~ NA,
                             DIABFLG == 1 ~ "Caused by diabetes",
                             DIABFLG == 2 ~ "Not caused by diabetes") %>% as.factor(),
         INJFLGX = case_when(INJFLGX %in% c(0, 6) ~ NA,
                             INJFLGX == 1 ~ "Result of injury",
                             INJFLGX == 2 ~ "Not result of injury") %>% as.factor(),
         ALLCON7A = na_if(ALLCON7A, 9),
         ALLCON7 = pmap(list(ALLCON7A, ALLCON7B, ALLCON7C, ALLCON7D, ALLCON7E,
                             ALLCON7F), function(...) {
                               vals = c(...)
                               if (anyNA(vals)) NA else vals
                             })
         ) %>% select(-c(LEVEL7, ALLCON7A:ALLCON7F))

# Visualise Missing Data
gg_miss_var(nhs5.data)

# Summary statistics
nhs5.data.categorical = nhs5.data %>% select(-c(ABSLID, ALLCON7))
lapply(nhs5.data.categorical, table)
```

# `AHSnhs11bhh.csv` Data Set

Again, for this one we will remove the replicate weights and identifiers.

```{r}
# Data Cleaning
nhs7 = read_csv(here("NHS", "AHSnhs11bhh.csv"))
counts = c(dim(nhs7)[1], n_distinct(nhs7$ABSLID))
cat("Total =", counts[1], "\nUnique =", counts[2])
nhs7.data = nhs7 %>% relocate(ABSLID) %>% 
  select(-c(WHROR01:WHROR60, LEVEL1, ABSPID:ABSMID)) %>% 
  relocate(STATE, .after = 1) %>% 
  mutate(STATE = case_when(STATE == 1 ~ "New South Wales",
                           STATE == 2 ~ "Victoria",
                           STATE == 3 ~ "Queensland",
                           STATE == 4 ~ "South Australia",
                           STATE == 5 ~ "Western Australia",
                           STATE == 6 ~ "Tasmania",
                           STATE == 7 ~ "Northern Territory",
                           STATE == 8 ~ "Australian Capital Territory") 
         %>% as.factor(),
         HHSIZECB = case_when(HHSIZECB == 1 ~ "One",
                              HHSIZECB == 2 ~ "Two",
                              HHSIZECB == 3 ~ "Three",
                              HHSIZECB == 4 ~ "Four",
                              HHSIZECB == 5 ~ "Five",
                              HHSIZECB == 6 ~ "Six or more") %>% as.factor(),
         DSMKHHRB = case_when(DSMKHHRB == 9 ~ NA,
                              DSMKHHRB == 0 ~ "None",
                              DSMKHHRB == 1 ~ "One",
                              DSMKHHRB == 2 ~ "Two",
                              DSMKHHRB == 3 ~ "Three or more") %>% as.factor(),
         LNDLORDB = case_when(LNDLORDB == 0 ~ NA,
                              LNDLORDB == 1 ~ "Private",
                              LNDLORDB == 2 ~ "Public",
                              LNDLORDB == 3 ~ "Other") %>% as.factor(),
         DWLSTRBC = case_when(DWLSTRBC == 8 ~ NA,
                              DWLSTRBC == 1 ~ "Separate house",
                              DWLSTRBC == 2 ~ "Semi-detached",
                              DWLSTRBC == 3 ~ "Flat or apartment",
                              DWLSTRBC == 4 ~ "Other dwelling") %>% as.factor(),
         NUMRMSBC = case_when(NUMRMSBC == 8 ~ NA,
                              NUMRMSBC == 0 ~ "None",
                              NUMRMSBC == 1 ~ "One",
                              NUMRMSBC == 2 ~ "Two",
                              NUMRMSBC == 3 ~ "Three",
                              NUMRMSBC == 4 ~ "Four or more") %>% as.factor(),
         ARIABC = case_when(ARIABC == 1 ~ "Major cities of Australia",
                            ARIABC == 2 ~ "Inner regional Australia",
                            ARIABC == 3 ~ "Other") %>% as.factor(),
         NUMKHHEC = case_when(NUMKHHEC == 0 ~ "None",
                              NUMKHHEC == 1 ~ "One",
                              NUMKHHEC == 2 ~ "Two",
                              NUMKHHEC == 3 ~ "Three",
                              NUMKHHEC == 4 ~ "Four or more") %>% as.factor(),
         HHADULEC = case_when(HHADULEC == 0 ~ "None",
                              HHADULEC == 1 ~ "One",
                              HHADULEC == 2 ~ "Two",
                              HHADULEC == 3 ~ "Three",
                              HHADULEC == 4 ~ "Four or more") %>% as.factor(),
         STHHTYC = case_when(STHHTYC == 1 ~ "One family household with only family members present", 
                             STHHTYC == 2 ~ "Two or more family household with only family members present",
                             STHHTYC == 3 ~ "One or more family household with non-family members present",
                             STHHTYC == 4 ~ "Lone person household",
                             STHHTYC == 5 ~ "Group household") %>% as.factor(),
         TENUREC = case_when(TENUREC == 1 ~ "Owner with a mortgage",
                             TENUREC == 2 ~ "Owner without a mortgage",
                             TENUREC == 3 ~ "Renter",
                             TENUREC == 4 ~ "Other") %>% as.factor(),
         INCDECE = case_when(INCDECE %in% c(98, 99) ~ NA,
                             TRUE ~ INCDECE) %>% as.factor(),
         FINSTRS = case_when(FINSTRS %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA,
                             FINSTRS == 1 ~ "Could raise $2000 in a week",
                             FINSTRS == 2 ~ "Could not raise $2000 in a week") %>% 
           as.factor(),
         SF2SA1DN = na_if(SF2SA1DN, 0) %>% as.factor(),
         SMKHSQ4D = case_when(SMKHSQ4D %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA,
                              SMKHSQ4D == 1 ~ "Smoked at home indoors",
                              SMKHSQ4D == 5 ~ "Did not smoke at home indoors") %>% 
           as.factor(),
         PHONEQ01 = case_when(PHONEQ01 == 8 ~ NA,
                              PHONEQ01 == 1 ~ "Has landline/fixed phone",
                              PHONEQ01 == 2 ~ "Does not have landline/fixed phone") %>% 
           as.factor(),
         LANDWH = case_when(LANDWH == 8 ~ NA,
                            LANDWH == 1 ~ "Has landline number in white pages",
                            LANDWH == 2 ~ "Does not have landline number in white pages",
                            LANDWH == 3 ~ "Does not have landline number") %>%
           as.factor()
         )
```

# Saving Files

This is so that I can share the cleaned files easily as `R` objects rather than saving as Excel files.

```{r}
saveRDS(nhs1.data, file = here("Objects", "AHSnhs11b14.rds"))
saveRDS(nhs2.data, file = here("Objects", "AHSnhs11ba3.rds"))

saveRDS(nhs8.data.cont, file = here("Objects", "AHSnhs11bsp.rds"))

# To access, use readRDS("Objects/file.rds)
```
